plugins.name: dynamic_tools
plugins.description: Dynamically loads .py tool files from .metalgate/tools (current project root + agent project root) and registers their callables as model tools. Exposes write_tool_file, reload_dynamic_tools, and list_dynamic_tools.
plugins.author: metalgate

plugins.name: context_tools
plugins.description: Real-time contextual symbol search for Go and Python: goto_definition, get_file_outline, get_source, get_callers, get_callees, find_symbol. Backed by ty (Python) and gopls (Go) language servers and tree-sitter.
plugins.author: metalgate
